commonSfxPromptSuffix: Original premium theatrical puzzle game sound. Warm brass, velvet stagecraft, polished wood and delicate crystal. Clear single readable event, restrained dynamics, clean isolated recording. No speech, no crowd, no music bed, no existing game imitation, no harsh distortion. Short natural decay, quiet background.
stingSfxPromptSuffix: Original premium theatrical puzzle game sound. Warm brass, velvet stagecraft, polished wood and delicate crystal. Clear single readable event, restrained dynamics, clean isolated recording. No speech, no crowd, no existing game imitation, no harsh distortion. Short natural decay, quiet background.
suffixPolicy: Common suffix is appended to all 39 SFX. For S33-S35 the spec allows a musical phrase instead of the common 'no music bed', so that clause is removed for those three. Ambience and music prompts have no suffix.
promptNormalization: Spaces lost in the spec formatting were restored ('in3/4' -> 'in 3/4', 'Dminor' -> 'D minor', 'in4/4' -> 'in 4/4'). Wording is otherwise verbatim.
durationPolicy: One-shots: requestDurationSeconds = max(0.5, ceil_0.1(target + max(0.2 s, 25% of target))) so the natural decay is generated, then trimmed to targetDuration with 2-10 ms fades. Loops (S37/A01/A02) are requested at the target length with loop=true. Music: music_length_ms 60000/80000/80000, force_instrumental=true, no seed, no composition_plan.
outputFormatPolicy: output_format is a query parameter. mp3_44100_128 is the default available on every plan; override per run with --output-format / --music-output-format if the account tier allows a better format (the override becomes part of the request hash).
variantPolicy: 1 variant per ID; at most 2 extra variants, only for IDs rejected by QA, only with the explicit --extra-variant flag; concurrency 1-2.
